scope: Final author clarifications integrated into permanent normative chapters, library contracts, examples and publication artifacts. This is not a production LMX execution report.

decisions.graph: The grouper consumes a clean graph and does not see parentheses or source-origin flags. References retain identity and actual parent.
operand_forms: arg0 operand arg1 arg2 (one left atom)
decisions.public_template: Unchanged: one left reference, right Array of references. The question of arbitrary operand position/two free argument arrays is closed.
decisions.phases: Grouping selects operations, dependencies and current-level sequences. A distinct application adapter prepares one left actual and right references. No subsequent unwrapping pass.
decisions.old_group_rule: Two material groups in group assignment expose their immediate sequences; only application adaptation packages the left sequence into the single left slot. Three sibling right groups remain three Structure items.
decisions.receiving_contracts: Modifiers and :: consume DATA. The common namespace field reader handles requested declaration sequences. Whole VALUE/TYPE/DATA are not automatically CODE. :: adds neither an RHS evaluator nor an inferred PASS flag.
decisions.copy: Bare copy(d) and a collected copy(d) are equivalent for the established group-assignment sequence consumer; scalar collectors remain.
decisions.effects: Every left retains the same occurrence/value-context view. Parser branches do not depend on assignment names or PLACE/NAME. The operand method consumes its own arguments through the ordinary namespace. Production demand/effect scheduling remains a separate integration requirement.
decisions.method_only_form_equivalence: (:= a 1) enters the method with ABSENT left and right [a,1]; (a := 1) enters with left a and right [1]. Only the method may implement equivalent meaning. Parser and transport preserve both distinct vectors.
decisions.attached_unary: One common structural class with side left/right and exactly one atom; no absorption of a following ordinary higher-priority operand.

normative_acceptance.static_check_scope: Top-level normative Markdown and two normative acceptance files; static source-format checks only

reference_algorithm.limits: The reference consumes an adapter graph view. Production resolution, complete designators, role/admission, numerical profiles, demanded scheduling, general effect order, short circuiting and activation lifetime are outside the supplied host model. receive_application requires an already demanded node with the surrounding context retained by the production executor.

read_only_review_followup.attached_unary_overcapture: FIXED: _attached_atom consumes only an atom/attachment chain; explicit regression passes
read_only_review_followup.host_effect_order_scope: Explicitly bounded; tiny model is not the production demand scheduler and makes no general effect-order or short-circuit claim.

library_review.current_source_note: One graph-terminology comment changed; two illustrative assignment sources and their combined copies shortened.

publication.style: Both full LMX forms. Full Throws. All equal comparable minima green and underlined.
publication.visual_scope: Changed pages of the three affected PDF artifacts and changed views of the three workbook artifacts; remaining 15+15 bytes retain the prior review.

verification_limits.reason: Production parser/translator/runtime sources and executables are not supplied. Normative fixtures remain targets; Python host tests and publication checks are separate evidence.

delivery: Changes-only cumulative archive against the exact uploaded baseline. Full file list/hashes/deletions in the archive-root change manifest.
